description: Java class PcbNode for parsing, representing, and manipulating PCB node data structures, including reading from files, parsing node hierarchies, and serialization.

classes.name: PcbNode
classes.description: Represents a node in a PCB design hierarchy, with methods for parsing, serialization, and node management.

methods.name: readFromFile
methods.description: Reads PCB node data from a file and parses it into a PcbNode object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the PcbNode.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a string content into a PcbNode hierarchy.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the PcbNode hierarchy into a string.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes the serialized node data to a file.

methods.name: setDouble
methods.description: Sets a child value at a specified index as a double.

methods.name: asDouble
methods.description: Retrieves a child value at a specified index as a double.

methods.name: hasChild
methods.description: Checks if a child with a specific key exists.

methods.name: findIfExists
methods.description: Finds a child node with a specific key if it exists.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds a unique child node with a specific key.

methods.name: nodes
methods.description: Returns a list of child nodes.

methods.name: iterate
methods.description: Returns a list of child nodes matching a specific key.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of children.

methods.name: getChild
methods.description: Retrieves a child value at a specific index.

methods.name: setString
methods.description: Sets a child value at a specific index as a string.

methods.name: setInt
methods.description: Sets a child value at a specific index as an integer.
